description: Counts of CELESTIA CONTENT indexed by blobpedia (how many CIPs, forum threads, docs, videos, etc.). This is INDEX/catalog coverage of what blobpedia has cataloged, NOT live chain state. For LIVE on-chain metrics (block height, TIA supply, validators, cumulative blob data) or TIA price/market, use get_network_state on THIS server instead. Zero arguments.
name: get_network_stats
